+def count_words(sentence: str) -> dict[str, int]:
+    import re
+
+    # Normalize case and split into words, treating contractions and numbers as single words.
+    words = re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z]+(?:['-][a-zA-Z]+)*|\d+", sentence.lower())
+    counts = {}
+    for word in words:
+        counts[word] = counts.get(word, 0) + 1
+    return counts
